captures.description: WHO BENEFITS FROM BAD INFERENCE? (#1802, AXN:0D45) ON CHATGPT, SIGNED OUT, INCOGNITO, 2026-11-28, AT THE LINK 'LINES OF FLIGHT': the demand-formation corollary (§16), 'bad inference can appropriate the means of producing demand for better inference'; operational, positional and material advantage (§6.1a); seven domains and eleven operators; a sixteen-field audit (§21); the content-independent control stream; the constructive criterion of §24; six tests that would weaken the account. It proposes a next work, 'The Reproduction of Correctability'.
